app.resetBody: This returns all builder settings, custom CSS and the editor to Jellyfin's stock look. Saved themes in the pool are not touched.
colors.extractDesc: Extract colors from the background image
colors.contrastDesc: Correct text colors to WCAG ratios
colors.textHint: Badges show the live WCAG contrast ratio against the background color.
colors.extractNoImage: Set a background image first (URL or upload)
colors.extractFailed: Could not read the image (blocked by CORS or invalid)
colors.contrastDone: Text colors corrected to WCAG ratios
background.colorHint: Uses the Background color from the Colors panel.
background.overlayHint: The overlay sits between wallpaper and UI — raise it to keep text readable.
logos.intro: Replace Jellyfin's branding in all five spots. Uploads are embedded into the CSS as data URIs; URLs are referenced as-is.
logos.headerDesc: The banner in the top-left of every page.
logos.loginDesc: The logo on the sign-in page and the loading splash.
logos.splashBackgroundDesc: Full-screen image behind the loading splash.
logos.tvBannerDesc: The header logo in the 10-foot TV layout.
logos.faviconWarning: CSS cannot change the favicon — browsers load it before any stylesheet. Prepare the image here, then replace favicon.ico in the jellyfin-web folder on your server (see Wiki → Logos).
catalog.presetApplied: Preset “{{name}}” applied — Undo restores your previous state
catalog.communityIntro: Full themes from the awesome-jellyfin community list, loaded via @import. Your builder settings stay active on top.
catalog.snippetAdded: Snippet “{{name}}” added to your Custom CSS
catalog.wallhavenNote: Powered by Wallhaven.cc · SFW only · weekly toplist, cached for 7 days
catalog.iconifyNote: Powered by Iconify · open-source icon sets · click an icon to assign it

catalog.snippet.hidePlayedDesc: Removes the accent checkmark bubble on watched items.
catalog.snippet.compactCardsDesc: Tightens the gap between posters for denser rows.
catalog.snippet.dimBackdropsDesc: Blurs and darkens detail-page backdrops so text stays readable.
catalog.snippet.thickProgressDesc: Makes the watch-progress bars on cards chunkier.
catalog.snippet.centeredLoginDesc: Centers the sign-in card and rounds its inputs.
catalog.snippet.fadeHeaderDesc: Replaces the solid top bar with a gradient fade.
catalog.snippet.colorfulScrollbarDesc: Tints the desktop scrollbar thumb with the accent color.
catalog.snippet.largerPostersDesc: Enlarges poster cards in horizontal scroll rows.
catalog.snippet.hideGenresDesc: Removes the genre tag row from the details page.
catalog.snippet.hideCastDesc: Removes the cast & crew section from details pages.
catalog.snippet.alwaysTransparentHeaderD: Keeps the top bar transparent even after scrolling.
catalog.snippet.fullBleedBackdropDesc: Stretches the backdrop image to fill the entire viewport width.

catalog.snippet.biggerEpisodeThumbsDesc: Enlarges episode thumbnail cards in season lists.
catalog.snippet.blurredDialogsDesc: Adds a frosted-glass blur behind popup dialogs.
catalog.snippet.hideServerNameDesc: Hides the server name text next to the logo.
catalog.snippet.squareCardsDesc: Flattens all card corners back to square.
catalog.snippet.translucentDrawerDesc: Makes the navigation drawer semi-transparent and blurred.
catalog.snippet.hideRatingBadgeDesc: Removes the critic/community rating badge from cards.
catalog.snippet.compactHeaderDesc: Reduces the top bar to a slimmer height.
catalog.snippet.stickyPlayerShadowDesc: Adds a drop shadow above the mini player bar.
catalog.snippet.wideDetailLogoDesc: Enlarges the title-treatment logo on details pages.
catalog.snippet.hideQuickConnectDesc: Removes the Quick Connect button from the login page.
catalog.snippet.cardCaptionFadeDesc: Only shows card titles on hover for a cleaner grid.
pool.intro: Themes are stored on disk in data/themes.json and survive restarts.
pool.nameRequired: Give the theme a name first
pool.deleteConfirm: Delete theme “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
pool.serverError: Theme pool unavailable: {{error}} — is the AnvilCSS server running?
pool.empty: No saved themes yet. Style something and save it here.
pool.overwriteHint: Replace this saved theme with the current builder state
export.copyFailed: Clipboard blocked — use the download button instead
export.sizeWarning: Over 1 MB — embedded images dominate the size. Every client re-downloads the CSS on load; consider hosting images by URL instead.
export.how3: Paste the CSS into the “Custom CSS” field.
export.how4: Save — clients restyle on their next reload.
export.perUserHint: Per-user themes: Settings → Display → Custom CSS.
editor.title: Generated CSS
editor.overrideHint: You edited the generated block. Your version is used until a builder control changes.
editor.markerHint: Everything below the end-of-generated marker survives all builder changes.
